phases.title: Repository foundation
phases.note: Repository structure, CI, privacy checks and public monitor are active.

phases.title: Canonicalize Apps Script baseline
phases.note: Complete privacy-audited Apps Script baseline is in the repo; DEFECT-001 is fixed in the repo baseline; production is unchanged.

phases.title: Baseline characterization tests
phases.note: Latest supplied runtime was compared against the repo baseline; critical legacy behaviors now have characterization tests or explicit compatibility policies.

phases.title: Core contracts
phases.note: Core identities, contracts, state machines, schemas, provenance and runtime version identity are implemented.

phases.title: Context Resolver
phases.note: Context Resolver and arbitrary-folder regression path are implemented and tested.

phases.title: Registry projections
phases.note: Context-scoped Drive registry writer now emits machine-readable context manifest plus source/artifact/evidence/processing projections; CI contract tests pass. Live Drive validation remains part of staging parity.

phases.title: Processor/provider boundaries
phases.note: Node/runtime processor boundaries, queue/retry policy, source-faithful processors, provider adapters, provider routing policy and runtime image/audio adapter wiring are implemented. Document-provider runtime wrapping remains before declaring complete.

phases.title: Knowledge staging/retrieval
phases.note: Knowledge packages, conflict records, bounded evidence retrieval and evidence-bounded semantic enrichment contracts are implemented and tested.

phases.title: Learner overlay/promotion
phases.note: Private learner-state, promotion policy and private promotion outbox models are implemented; automated private-backend consumption remains.

phases.title: Repo-driven runtime deployment
phases.note: Repo-driven Apps Script build, Git identity, guarded staging package, Context Resolver/runtime adapters, Drive registry writer and staging registry probe are ready; a real staging Apps Script project/auth target remains.

phases.title: Real-source parity/release
phases.note: Synthetic parity and non-destructive staging probes are ready; live Drive/Gemini staging execution and rollback validation remain.
